articles.title: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
articles.description: The US president says the landmark agreement to help Saudis develop nuclear energy is dependent on it joining the Abraham Accords.

articles.title: Ex-governor convicted of murdering a pregnant student in Kenya
articles.description: Okoth Obado was found guilty of killing Sharon Otieno with whom he had had an affair.

articles.title: Norway Viking Row gets ‘resign’ twist in ‘Cockroach’ protest
articles.description: Cockroach Janty Party-led protesters in Mumbai, India recreated Norway’s viral Viking Row, replacing ‘ro’ with ‘resign’.

articles.title: 'Let's enjoy the ride' says Elon Musk, as AI fears mount
articles.description: Talking to The Economist, Musk said he doesn't care if people hate him and said he was not a racist.

articles.title: South Korea woman acquitted of murdering newborn after hospital delivery
articles.description: The woman, who had wanted to end her pregnancy at 36 weeks, gave birth to a baby who doctors later killed.

articles.title: Watch: Louvre reopens gallery after jewellery heist
articles.description: The Louvre Museum reopens its Apollo Gallery nine months after a robbery that shocked France.
